title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP tasks can ask for missing information or authorisation
summary: The briefing agrees with the roadmap and supports its licensing, existing controls and API calls with Microsoft documentation. Its elicitation-specific uncertainties remain appropriately qualified. Clarify the monitoring note so readers do not mistake dashboard metrics for fields returned by the service-usage API.
